card.name: Digits in phone country codes
card.fires_on: The digit after +4 in international phone numbers, mostly the 9 of +49 (Germany) and the 1 of +41 (Switzerland). Also fires on digits inside URLs and DOIs, and on the bracket in fax numbers.

modes.label: Country code digit
modes.description: The second digit of a +4x country code in a contact line.

modes.label: Digits in links
modes.description: A digit inside a handle URL or DOI string.

modes.label: Fax number bracket
modes.description: The opening bracket of an area code after fax.

card.plain: It lights up on the digit that finishes a European country code in a contact phone number.
